outcome: Maternal outcomes (HELLP syndrome, placental abruption, eclampsia, maternal death)
Perinatal complications (preterm delivery, stillbirth, perinatal mortality)
cohort: The study included 255 women with hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP) who delivered at the National Hospital of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Vietnam, between March 2023 and July 2023.
finding: The study found HELLP syndrome, placental abruption, and eclampsia to be the most common adverse maternal outcomes, while preterm delivery was the most common perinatal complication, with highest diastolic BP, severity symptoms, and birth weight identified as independent predictors of adverse perinatal outcome.
